A listener *observes* a run. A **pre-run modifier** *changes* it — before any
test executes. It is a `SuiteVisitor`: Robot Framework walks your suites and
calls your visit methods, and you edit what is there. Select a subset, skip
tests, add tags, reorder — all decided from code, at run time.

You attach one with `--prerunmodifier`. Overriding `start_suite(self, suite)`
lets you rewrite `suite.tests` before the suite runs.

```diagram
pipeline "Where a pre-run modifier acts"
parse -- build the suite model
PreRunModifier :accent -- edits suites before they run
execute -- only the kept tests run
report -- output.xml, log, report
note "--prerunmodifier runs before any test executes"
```

## Task 1 — Keep only the smoke tests

**Goal:** create `ext/SmokeOnly.py` — a `SuiteVisitor` whose `start_suite` keeps
only the tests tagged `smoke`.

Here is the same base class doing a different edit — adding a tag. Adapt it to
*filter* to smoke-tagged tests instead.

<!-- example -->
```python
from robot.api import SuiteVisitor


class TagOrders(SuiteVisitor):
    def start_suite(self, suite):
        for test in suite.tests:
            if "Order" in test.name:
                test.tags.add("orders")
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `ext/SmokeOnly.py` defines a `SuiteVisitor`.

<!-- hint -->
Subclass the visitor and override `start_suite`:
`class SmokeOnly(SuiteVisitor):` with `def start_suite(self, suite):`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Replace the suite's tests with just the smoke-tagged ones:
`suite.tests = [t for t in suite.tests if "smoke" in t.tags]`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```python
from robot.api import SuiteVisitor


class SmokeOnly(SuiteVisitor):
    def start_suite(self, suite):
        suite.tests = [test for test in suite.tests if "smoke" in test.tags]
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run with your modifier

The bundled `checks/orders.robot` has two `smoke`-tagged tests and two that are
not. Attach your modifier:

```bash
uv run robot --prerunmodifier ext/SmokeOnly.py checks/orders.robot
```

Only the two smoke tests run — the others were removed before execution.

**Check:** with the modifier, only the smoke-tagged tests run.
